ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with an estimated 0.10 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily at the distal tips and within focal surface anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottling clustered at the extreme distal tips; sparse, high-contrast white circular focal spots and thin linear marks distributed across a primary black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to the inferior leading edges, sweeping upwards towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (approximately 5-12 pixels in diameter) scattered across the right lobe and densely packed at both distal tips, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; most prominent is a diagonal mark extending from the median notch area towards the lower right lobe, with shorter vertical marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive focal scarring and barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; multiple linear rake marks distributed across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly textured, protruding three-dimensional white clusters at the extreme distal edges of the fluke lobes.
